name: Enugu
scopeLimits: Enugu State’s ENGIS and the Office of the Surveyor General describe state land-record and parcel-mapping services, including registered survey plans, but the reviewed map viewer’s Launch Map Viewer link redirected to an account login. The page states that accounts are needed for land services and that historical survey lookup requires a ₦10,000 payment. No login, payment or property search was submitted. No anonymous parcel feature/ID or exact point-to-digitized-coverage result was verified at the Enugu WUP locator.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official ENGIS describes state parcel mapping and land-registry services and places its agency headquarters in Independence Layout, Enugu city. The official Surveyor General office describes cadastral maps, deposited survey records and boundary documentation and places its office in GRA, Enugu. This directly establishes local city registry/mapping activity; it does not establish digital parcel coverage at the WUP point.
technicalBlocker: The available map feature link redirected to an account login; no anonymous vector query endpoint was exposed by the public page reviewed.
remainingUncertainty: Actual ENGIS digitized-LGA coverage at the WUP point, viewer service endpoints and public geometry access remain unverified. ENGIS says it has progressively digitized LGAs; statewide platform language is not proof every locality is mapped.
nextStep: Root review the state registry finding; if city-specific geometry is needed, request an official public map endpoint or non-sensitive coverage statement from ENGIS without using account-gated land searches.
